title: Vision screenshot understanding reliability
goal: Measure screenshot structure, state, and actionable-control recognition.
prompt: Use vision.analyze with mode screenshot, detail standard, and output detailed. Describe visible status, queue state, deployment version/time, and actionable controls.
prerequisites: Configure and explicitly enable a vision-capable live route.
steps: Run the screenshot prompt against the deterministic dashboard fixture.
Score the five expected facts from manifest.json.
Record invented UI controls or states as hallucinations.
assertions: API health and worker queue state are correct.
Version and time are copied exactly.
View logs is identified as a visible control without claiming it was clicked.
notes: Accuracy percent uses the five expected manifest items.
